stage_name: Stage 2: Logistics & Supply Chain Deep Dive

questions.scenario: You are playing a city-building game (like SimCity or Clash of Clans). What do you enjoy the most?

options.text: Sending out fast delivery riders to complete quick missions.
Trading resources and coins with other players across the map.
Managing your storage so the resource boxes never get completely full.
Building smooth roads and railway tracks so traffic doesn't jam.
Looking at the data dashboards to predict exactly how much food and electricity the city will need tomorrow.
None of these.

questions.scenario: Your school is organizing a massive farewell party. What is your role?

options.text: Making sure the pizza and cold drinks arrive exactly on time.
Getting special permissions from the Principal to bring outside DJs.
Organizing the backstage room so props and food are perfectly stacked.
Arranging buses and cabs so everyone gets home safely after the party.
Calculating the exact budget, finding the best vendors, and buying all supplies at a wholesale discount.
None of these.

questions.scenario: When you order something from Amazon or Swiggy, what fascinates you the most?

options.text: Watching the live map as the delivery rider zooms towards my house.
If the product is coming from another country and how it crosses borders.
The 'Only 2 items left in stock' tag. How does their system know?!
Wondering if my package is traveling by plane, train, or a big truck.
How the app's algorithm predicts exactly what I want to buy next and suggests the best combos.
None of these.

questions.scenario: Your family is shifting to a new house. There are 100 boxes. What do you do?

options.text: Track the moving guys to see exactly what time they will reach.
Handle the gate-pass, society permissions, and society paperwork.
Label and stack the boxes safely like a puzzle so nothing breaks.
Sit in the truck and navigate the driver through the best shortcuts.
Make a detailed master spreadsheet of all items and negotiate the best price with the packers.
None of these.

questions.scenario: If you had a Logistics Superpower, what would it be?

options.text: Teleporting a package into someone's hands instantly.
A magical pass that lets me cross any border or security check safely.
A magical pocket where I can store 10,000 items in perfect order.
Controlling all city traffic lights so my car never has to stop.
The ability to instantly calculate the exact cost, time, and materials needed for any massive project.
None of these.

questions.scenario: You are going on a road trip with 5 friends. What is your special job?

options.text: Passing out the snacks and drinks to everyone quickly during the ride.
Keeping all the ID cards, toll tickets, and hotel bookings safe.
Packing the car trunk (boot) so all 10 bags fit perfectly like Tetris.
Looking at Google Maps, deciding the route, and managing fuel stops.
Collecting everyone's money in advance and buying all the trip supplies in bulk at a discount.
None of these.

questions.scenario: In an action movie, which character's job looks the coolest?

options.text: The bike messenger zipping through traffic to deliver the secret antidote.
The smart agent who legally smuggles a spy across an international border.
The guy managing a massive underground vault of secret weapons.
The expert getaway driver who knows every street and shortcut in the city.
The mastermind sitting at the computer, calculating the exact timing and resources needed for the heist.
None of these.

questions.scenario: Every job has a 'boring' part. Which of these headaches can you handle with a smile?

options.text: Handling angry customers because a delivery rider is 10 minutes late.
Filling out 5 pages of boring legal forms just to send one parcel abroad.
Counting 5,000 identical pencils to make sure the storeroom is perfect.
Waking up at 4 AM to make sure the transport buses leave on time.
Staring at complex Excel sheets for hours to figure out why the company is losing money on packaging.
None of these.

questions.scenario: Playing an open-world game (like GTA or Truck Simulator), what's your favorite mission?

options.text: The time-limit pizza delivery missions on a scooter.
The missions where you have to sneak cargo past the police.
Buying big garages and organizing all your cool cars in them.
Driving massive trucks across the long highway maps.
Buying businesses, managing their stock levels, and watching the passive income grow on the stats screen.
None of these.

questions.scenario: In your friend group, what title fits you the best?

options.text: The Runner (Always on the move, gets things done fast).
The Diplomat (Gets permissions and handles the rules).
The Organizer (Keeps everything safe, sorted, and secure).
The Navigator (Knows the best routes and handles the ride).
The Mastermind (The one who budgets, plans ahead, and gets the best deals).
None of these.
